parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer that slides in and out of the table cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as utensils, stationery, or tools.
parts.Movement_description: Slides horizontally in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: Another wooden drawer located beside or below the first one.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage space for small items.
parts.Movement_description: Slides horizontally in and out along rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden door attached to the front of the cabinet section.
parts.Functional_description: Covers and protects the storage compartment inside the table.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates about vertical hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: Another wooden cabinet door paired with the first one.
parts.Functional_description: Provides access to the other side of the storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates about vertical hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A thin plywood panel forming the back of the table cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and encloses the rear of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming one side of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral structural support and defines the cabinet boundary.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: The opposite vertical wooden side panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural stability and defines the cabinet’s other side.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden front frame that supports drawers and doors.
parts.Functional_description: Holds the drawers and doors in alignment and provides front structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden base panel forming the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the weight of stored items and stabilizes the structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A metal rod or bar connecting the tabletop to the cabinet frame.
parts.Functional_description: Provides mechanical connection and reinforcement between tabletop and cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, may allow slight flex under load.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a working or display surface for various activities.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move.
